character.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create an updated character reference sheet based on the BLUE CREATURE in the supplied UI screenshot. Preserve its recognizable face, slate-blue/lavender fur, cream muzzle/chest, amber eyes, pointed ears, orange neckerchief, navy casual jacket and polished soft 3D game-art rendering. CRITICAL CHANGES: remove ALL WINGS completely from its anatomy, leaving natural shoulders/back, not folded or hidden wings. Remove glowing circuit patterns on sleeves, keep tasteful simple cyan piping only. This is the same liked character, not a new design. Four equally sized panels in one wide 16:9 sheet, chest-up/waist-up, dark slate #181B22 background, clean off-white labels below. Panel1 'Lyssnar': front-facing direct eye contact, mouth closed, interested head tilt. Panel2 'Pratar': front-facing direct eye contact with viewer, warm open-mouth smile and small open hand gesture. Panel3 'Tänker': positioned in right part of its panel, body and nose turn to VIEWER'S LEFT, pupils look left toward the CENTER/board, hand gently on chin. Panel4 'Väntar': front facing or a slight VIEWER-LEFT gaze down toward work, relaxed hands, mouth closed. Every face is either frontal at the camera or turned toward VIEWER'S LEFT; no face or pupils look to the right/outside screen. No wings of any size, no wing membranes, no shoulder fins. No extra creature candidates, props, whiteboards, logos, trademarks, decorative UI, frames, neon. This sheet is character art only.

On RIGHT side of app, face looks DIRECTLY at camera/learner or nose and pupils turn gently toward VIEWER'S LEFT into center/board. NEVER gaze toward right edge or outside frame.
